author: pokon548
quote_zh: 人一生的大部分时间都是平淡无奇的。这也是我们身体养精蓄锐的必要条件。因为只有身心在泛起涟漪的生活中得到充分的修正，才能圆满的迎接人生的下一次高峰。
quote_en: Most of a person's life is bland. This is also a necessary condition for our body to nourish and accumulate sperm. Because only when the body and mind are fully corrected in the rippling life can we fully meet the next peak of life.
